---
title: 'Appendix G — Monthly panel (Table G.1)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_monthly.parquet"))
data_quarterly <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Activations and closures in the monthly panel

```{r}
data |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(change = treatment - lag(treatment)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarise(
    n_activation_events = sum(change == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_exit_events       = sum(change == -1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Months without the program in the first three treated quarters

```{r}
first_quarter <- data_quarterly |>
  filter(treatment == 1) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  summarise(first_quarter = min(date))

data |>
  inner_join(first_quarter, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  filter(floor_date(date, "quarter") >= first_quarter,
         floor_date(date, "quarter") <  first_quarter + months(9)) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  summarise(months_without_program = sum(treatment == 0)) |>
  summarise(mean_months_without_program = mean(months_without_program))
```

## Table G.1, Panels A and B (k = 12)

```{r}
mm12_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df = data,
  outcome = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group = "id",
  time = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects = 12,
  placebo = 6
)
print(mm12_nc)
```
